program.section_heading: Spanish/English Healthcare Interpreter Training — Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Demonstrate a high intermediate/advanced linguistic proficiency in speaking, listening, and reading as applied to the use of the three modes (consecutive and simultaneous interpretation, and sight translation) in healthcare interpreting settings.
Apply critical thinking, cultural responsiveness and linguistic skills to successfully identify and manage potential communication- and ethical-pitfalls in healthcare settings.

Locate and articulate the resources that are available to pursue continuing education opportunities in the field, to obtain formal assessments of their specific linguistic proficiency levels, and to pursue national interpreting certifications.

notes: The catalog states 'the 39-unit major' and 'Required Major Total Units 39'; the Required Courses sum to 19 units and the Spanish Language Requirement (SPAN 001-004) to 20, which together match 39.

The Spanish Language Requirement also lists 'SPAN 001-004 through Credit For Prior Learning 0-20', so some or all of SPAN 001-004 may be satisfied via credit for prior learning; this alternate path is not a course and is recorded only here.

The 'Required Major Total Units 39' line is printed under the Required Courses list but appears to cover both lists; the Spanish Language Requirement is printed after page boilerplate on the same page.
Catalog codes OCED 090, COMM 012 and SPAN 001-004 are zero-padded forms of closed-list OCED 90, COMM 12 and SPAN 1-4; treated as the same courses.
PDF ligature artifacts (e.g., 'Ɵ', 'ﬁ', 'seƫ n gs', 'piƞ alls') were read as 'ti', 'fi', 'settings', 'pitfalls' in the outcomes and careers.
